description.en: A semantic package over the Metropolitan Museum of Art's Open Access catalogue held in the semvia-test-data Postgres instance. Ships a small museum-object ontology, the nineteen curatorial departments as a SKOS scheme, an svdb:PostgresConnection descriptor carrying no credential, and two RML TriplesMaps that read one 54-column relation as objects and as the artists attributed to them — nothing is copied, every read is answered by the database.
